senses.en: to slap lightly (jokingly) at the cheeks
to cover (a pot), to cover with a sheet of paper, cloth, etc., thatch (v.)
to chase, to pursue, to run after (an animal), to drive away (as flies)
to shake off the dust by holding the clothes with both hands
to cut wood or bamboo into small pieces
to drown, to submerge, to inundate
to snatch, to pick up, to nip
to hook up, to hang on a peg or a hook, to suspend, to hang
to have mote in the eye
to light in the dark, to carry a burning firewood or bamboo or anything to make fire at another place
to catch fish with Derris poison
to hit, to strike with a fist
